model.refusal: × refuse — the accent, not an evidence state
model.two_levels: a receipt is constructed once sealed and checked only when a receipted verify covers it (index ≤ the named head); a claim backed by a receipt (journey step done, run sealed) is checked by that receipt
model.precedence: refused > stale > inferred > checked > constructed > declared
model.reservation: circle set reserved for evidence; card diamonds ◇/◆ chrome; connectivity ■/□ (LIVE); attention ▶; progress ▮▯; contract test proves disjoint
